QUOTE: Add a `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME> -0x....` in that module's public header... Do not hand-edit `error.c`. The next build overwrites it. ... Rebuild through the normal CMake build. `error.c` is regenerated
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer covers adding a #define to the public header and regenerating, but it never says the define must be documented with a /** */ comment. It explicitly says the description source is unverified ("most likely source is the header's doc comment, but I have not verified it"), so the documented-define mechanism is not stated.
